recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future clarification should be raised as a new current-resource issue about ActivityDefinition, StructureDefinition logical models, or catalogs rather than reviving retired DataElement wording.
issue_request: FHIR-11321 was a Published/Persuasive OO clarification request from the DSTU2 ballot asking the DataElement scope/boundaries section to explain overlap with ActivityDefinition: ActivityDefinition defines actions that can occur, DataElement defines individual pieces of data that can be captured, and an ActivityDefinition focused on data capture might link to the DataElement defining that data.
initial_application: Git commit 47cf96aa02e8bf8507221108c41aa24eda5a8e02 explicitly named #11321 and added the approved ActivityDefinition/DataElement paragraph to source/dataelement/dataelement-introduction.xml.
additional_context: The companion ActivityDefinition-side issue FHIR-11505 is already represented on the combined branch by 57beecc49f7cc64d68d3ce5b6653d0f977a5331f. The later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-13094 collapsed DataElement into StructureDefinition logical models and is already represented on the combined branch by c1a07840fdc89786d1b71cdd5f635e9032155d72. Current source has DataElement commented out in source/fhir.ini, no source/dataelement resource directory, and source/history.html lists DataElement as a removed resource.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring the old DataElement boundary prose would document a retired resource, and adding new ActivityDefinition-to-StructureDefinition comparison prose would be broader than the seed and duplicate later FHIR-13094 work.
